title: Assembly of a locally improving finite free tower
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $M$ a cochain complex of $A$-modules, $(f_j)$ a finite family of elements, and $b\in\mathbb Z$. Let $F_k$ be complexes indexed by $k\in\mathbb N$, with chain maps $\alpha_k:F_k\to M$ and $\tau_k:F_k\to F_{k+1}$ such that $\tau_k\alpha_{k+1}=\alpha_k$. Each $F_k$ is zero above $b$ and has finitely generated free terms. Suppose $\tau_k^i$ is invertible whenever $b+1-k\le i$, and $H^i((\alpha_k)_{f_j})$ is invertible whenever $b+1-k<i$. Then there is a complex $E$, zero above $b$ and termwise finite free, and a chain map $\gamma:E\to M$ such that $H^i(\gamma_{f_j})$ is invertible for every $i,j$. The localizations are extension of scalars to $A_{f_j}$. No pseudo-coherence, unit ideal, or global quasi-isomorphism hypothesis is made.

proof.text: Use Functor.ofSequence on the transitions. For every degree i and k with b+1-k<=i, induct on the later index to prove each composite from k invertible in degree i. Apply Mathlib Functor.IsEventuallyConstantFrom.hasColimit to each evaluated diagram. Mathlib HomologicalComplexLimits constructs the degreewise colimit complex E, and the maps alpha form a cocone inducing gamma:E to M.

Functor.IsEventuallyConstantFrom.isIso_ι_of_isColimit shows the inclusion from stage k is invertible in degree i whenever b+1-k<=i. Take k=(b+1-i).toNat. Transport Module.Free and Module.Finite using the linear equivalence of this component isomorphism, and transport termwise vanishing above b. This gives the required upper bound and finite free terms.

For cohomology in degree i take k=(b+2-i).toNat. The localized stage inclusion is invertible in i-1,i,i+1, because localization preserves isomorphisms. Apply ShortComplex.quasiIso_of_epi_of_isIso_of_mono to its three-term short complex to get QuasiIsoAt at i. The colimit factorization gives inclusion followed by gamma=alpha_k. Since alpha_k is a localized quasi-isomorphism in degree i, quasiIsoAt_of_comp_left gives the same for gamma. Apply quasiIso_iff in all degrees.

lean.statement: theorem exists_model_of_stabilized_finite_free_tower (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A) (b : ℤ) (F : ℕ → CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (α : ∀ k : ℕ, F k ⟶ M) (τ : ∀ k : ℕ, F k ⟶ F (k + 1)) (hupper : ∀ k : ℕ, (F k).IsStrictlyLE b) (hfinite : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ i : ℤ, Module.Free A ((F k).X i) ∧ Module.Finite A ((F k).X i)) (hcomm : ∀ k : ℕ, τ k ≫ α (k + 1) = α k) (hstable : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ i : ℤ, b + 1 - (k : ℤ) ≤ i → IsIso ((τ k).f i)) (hiso : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ j : Fin r, ∀ i : ℤ, b + 1 - (k : ℤ) < i → QuasiIsoAt ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap A (Localization.Away (f j)))) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map (α k)) i) : ∃ (E : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ), E.IsStrictlyLE b ∧ (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Free A (E.X i) ∧ Module.Finite A (E.X i)) ∧ ∃ γ : E ⟶ M, ∀ j : Fin r, QuasiIso ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap A (Localization.Away (f j)))) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map γ)
